name: Naveo
tagline: Church operations that don't require a miracle.
positioning: Enterprise-grade admin software for multi-site churches: giving, membership, scheduling, and pastoral care in one calm dashboard.

hero.h1: Run your church like it's not held together with tape.
hero.sub: Naveo consolidates giving, membership rolls, volunteer scheduling, and pastoral follow-ups across every campus — so your ops team stops living inside seventeen spreadsheets.

features.title: Giving that reconciles itself
features.description: Pull tithes, pledges, and one-off donations from every channel into one ledger. Year-end statements generate in a click, not a prayer.

features.title: Rolls that stay clean
features.description: Merge duplicate member records, track households across campuses, and flag the 400 people who left in 2019 but are still on your email blast.

features.title: Scheduling without the group text
features.description: Assign greeters, nursery, and worship teams with conflict detection. Volunteers confirm from their phone. You stop begging.

features.title: Pastoral care, actually tracked
features.description: Log hospital visits, prayer requests, and follow-ups so nothing falls through the cracks when a pastor takes sabbatical.

features.title: Multi-site by design
features.description: Roll up giving and attendance across all locations, then drill into a single campus without swapping logins.

features.title: Permissions the board approves
features.description: Granular roles and audit logs so your treasurer sees finances and your youth intern absolutely does not.

testimonials.quote: We migrated 34,000 member records off a database our IT guy built in 2008 and quit over. Naveo did it in a weekend. Nobody prayed about it once.
testimonials.name: Marcus Delaney

testimonials.quote: Year-end giving statements used to eat three staff members for two weeks. Now it's a Tuesday afternoon and a coffee. My finance team stopped threatening to leave.
testimonials.name: Priya Ramanathan

testimonials.quote: The volunteer scheduling alone paid for itself. We went from 60 no-shows a month to arguing about who gets the good parking spots.
testimonials.name: Dale Whitmore

pricing.blurb: For single-campus churches finally leaving the binder era.
For growing multi-site churches that need it all to reconcile.
For denominations and large networks with real compliance needs.

homepage.footerBlurb: Naveo is church administration software for people who'd rather do ministry than data entry. Multi-site ready. Board approved.
